title: wollastonia integrifolia
intro: Wollastonia integrifolia, commonly known as the whole-leaf Wollastonia, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, native to Australia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and skin infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and exhibiting antioxidant properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Wollastonia integrifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
